join_feasibility.reason: audit.csv keys on HADM_ID+drug; gold file keys on pair_id only; no overlapping column
join_feasibility.conclusion: Row order in audit.csv carries no alignment to gold pair_id order (observed match ~= chance). A true pair-level join (Llama weak label vs pharmacist label on the SAME note pair) is not reconstructable from the released, de-identified files. Falling back to rule-stratified (many-to-one) comparison, which is valid because rule membership counts match exactly (299=299) and rule is the only variable shared across both files.

weak_confidence_is_degenerate.finding: weak_confidence takes exactly 2 values (0.95, 1.00), and is a deterministic function of weak_label (0.95 iff contradiction, 1.00 iff not_contradiction) in all 1679 training rows and all 299 audit rows. It is not a real graded confidence score -- it cannot be swept as a threshold because it carries zero information beyond the label itself. Confidence-threshold precision curves (0.5/0.7/0.9/0.95) are therefore not meaningful: at any threshold <=0.95 every row passes; at 1.00 only not_contradiction rows pass by construction.
